results.overview: The pod is running and it answers its probes. It just won't say a word.
A pod starts, crashes, waits a little longer, and starts again. And again. And again.
Every night, the same chart upgrades itself. Nobody remembers changing values.yaml.
The head of the Deployment family makes every node a resource request it can't refuse.
She asked for 128Mi. She used 129. Now the kernel is coming for her.
A cluster upgrade drains the nodes one by one. The oldest pods have nowhere left to run.

results.original_title: The Good, the Bad and the Evicted
results.overview: Three pods. One node. Not enough memory for all of them.
